title: IESO result, format 1
description: An IESO result: OptimalResult when solver.stat_succ is 1 (check system.accounting_ok), UnsuccessfulResult when it is 0 (inputs, status and provenance only). This schema describes structure only. Unique identifiers, references between objects, thermal topology, profile files and their contents and lengths, hourly shortfall bounds and thermodynamic admissibility are checked by IESO (ieso validate CASE.json). A valid case may still define an infeasible optimisation problem.

Accounts.description: The quantities behind the cost KPI (active demands only).

allocation_share.description: Share of total electricity-equivalent output allocated to this commodity; null when the system produced no output.
allocation_share.title: Allocation share

resource_cost.description: System cost allocated (USD); excludes shortage penalties.
resource_cost.title: Resource cost

shortage_penalty.description: unmet_demand x var_cost_ns (USD): a modelled price, not spend.
shortage_penalty.title: Shortage penalty

resource_cost_per_served.description: resource_cost / served_demand (USD/unit); null when nothing was served.
resource_cost_per_served.title: Resource cost per served

surplus.description: Annual sum of the surplus series, in the commodity's unit.
surplus.title: Surplus

Accounts.title: Accounts

share.description: Share of total output; null when there is no output.
share.title: Share

Availability.description: What the availability profile asked for against what it delivered.

profile_peak.description: Maximum of the rescaled availability series.
profile_peak.title: Profile peak

hours_above_nameplate.description: Hours in which the rescaled series exceeds one.
hours_above_nameplate.title: Hours above nameplate

capacity_factor_effective.description: Mean availability once output is held to capacity.
capacity_factor_effective.title: Capacity factor effective

CapDetail.description: What was observed on a cap row, kept apart from its interpretation.

raw_dual.description: The row dual as returned by the solver.
raw_dual.title: Raw dual

activity.description: The row activity at the solution.
activity.title: Activity

binding.description: Whether the row is at its cap (within tolerance).

binding_zero_dual.description: Binding with a zero dual: degenerate, or a genuinely worthless cap. IESO does not tell them apart.
binding_zero_dual.title: Binding zero dual

CapDetail.title: CapDetail

CommodityDemand.description:
Final demand for a Power-to-X commodity (heat, hydrogen, water...).

A demand with ``total`` 0 is inactive: it builds nothing, and its penalty,
shortfall bounds and profile are not read.

iden.description: Identifier of the commodity, unique among demands.
iden.title: Identifier

anyOf.description: a CSV file path (one value per line, no header), or '' for a flat profile
one value per hour

profile.description: Shape of hourly demand. Hourly shape: '' for a flat profile, a CSV file path (resolved against the input file's directory, or an explicit profile base; never the working directory), or a list with one value per hour (8760). Values must be finite, non-negative and not all zero.
profile.title: Profile

total.description: Annual demand in the commodity's unit (m3, kg, MWh of heat...). 0 makes the demand inactive.
total.title: Annual total

supply_sources.description: Identifiers of the processes (p2x) that deliver this commodity. A process may supply at most one active demand.
supply_sources.title: Supply sources

var_cost_ns.description: Penalty per unit of unmet demand (USD per unit). Required when the demand is active.
var_cost_ns.title: Shortfall penalty

l_ns.description: [low, high] bounds on unmet demand in each hour. Required, as a pair, when the demand is active; an inactive demand may give [] or omit it.
l_ns.title: Shortfall bounds
